acceptanceCriteria: internal/tasks/store completes under -timeout 30m at a 1-min load average of at least 60 on the dev host in 3 consecutive runs, with per-test durations recorded before and after.
No program_* assertion is weakened; any fixture sharing preserves test isolation.
body: Observed 2026-10-16 by the V1-1497 lane (PR #977; Darwin arm64, Go 1.27.1, load average 52-102) and earlier by the V1-1459 lane (PR #974): `go test -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/tasks/store/` hits the 30m package timeout with program_* tests reporting context canceled. The program_* tests take 40-93 s each under load and together exceed the package budget. This is a different class from V1-1497 (a per-test 2 s deadline). Same class as V1-1001 (doccorpus) and V1-1482 (dogfoodflow). Expected: the package finishes inside the 30m hang detector under shared CI/host load (decision 0082), e.g. by parallelizing or sharing program fixtures, or by splitting the package. Actual: package-level timeout.
title: tests: internal/tasks/store package exceeds the 30m package timeout under load (slow program_* tests)
